context: Attribute names with labels, levels, variable role (root_cause / pathophysiology / hemodynamic_measurement / oxygenation / ventilation_measurement / ventilator_setting / device_state / derived_monitor / alarm_flag), subsystem, and brief clinical description — functional context without explicit causal direction.

variables.name: CVP
variables.label: Central venous pressure
variables.description: Pressure measured in the right atrium or superior vena cava; reflects right-heart preload and overall venous volume status.

variables.name: PCWP
variables.label: Pulmonary capillary wedge pressure
variables.description: Occlusion pressure in a pulmonary artery branch; approximates left atrial pressure and left-heart preload.

variables.name: HIST
variables.label: Patient history flag
variables.description: Binary indicator encoding whether clinically relevant patient history (e.g., prior cardiac disease) is present; used as a baseline risk modifier.

variables.name: TPR
variables.label: Total peripheral resistance
variables.description: Systemic vascular resistance reflecting arteriolar tone; a key determinant of afterload and arterial blood pressure.

variables.name: BP
variables.label: Blood pressure
variables.description: Systemic arterial pressure; the product of cardiac output and total peripheral resistance.

variables.name: CO
variables.label: Cardiac output
variables.description: Volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute; equal to heart rate multiplied by stroke volume.

variables.name: HRBP
variables.label: Heart rate / blood pressure index
variables.description: Derived monitoring index combining HR and BP signals; used to detect haemodynamically significant HR abnormalities.

variables.name: HREK
variables.label: Heart rate from EKG
variables.description: Heart rate as read from the EKG monitor; an electrophysiological observation of true underlying HR.

variables.name: HRSA
variables.label: Heart rate / oxygen saturation index
variables.description: Derived monitoring index combining HR and SAO2 signals; flags HR abnormalities in the context of oxygenation status.

variables.name: PAP
variables.label: Pulmonary artery pressure
variables.description: Pressure in the pulmonary arterial circulation; elevated by pulmonary embolus or left-heart failure.

variables.name: SAO2
variables.label: Arterial oxygen saturation
variables.description: Percentage of haemoglobin saturated with oxygen in arterial blood; determined by alveolar ventilation, FIO2, and intrapulmonary shunting.

variables.name: FIO2
variables.label: Fraction of inspired oxygen
variables.description: Fraction of oxygen in the gas delivered to the patient; a ventilator-controlled input that directly determines oxygen availability.

variables.name: PRSS
variables.label: Breathing circuit pressure
variables.description: Observed airway/circuit pressure during ventilation; affected by tube kinking, disconnection, and machine output.

variables.name: ECO2
variables.label: Expired CO2
variables.description: End-tidal or mixed expired CO2 concentration; reflects alveolar ventilation and CO2 production.

variables.name: MINV
variables.label: Minute ventilation (observed)
variables.description: Measured total ventilation per minute; can deviate from the set target due to tube or circuit problems.

variables.name: MVS
variables.label: Minute ventilation set (target)
variables.description: Clinician-set target for minute ventilation; a root input variable representing the intended ventilation prescription.

variables.name: HYP
variables.label: Hypovolemia
variables.description: Reduced circulating blood volume; a primary cause of decreased cardiac preload and output.

variables.name: LVF
variables.label: Left ventricular failure
variables.description: Impaired left ventricular contractility; reduces stroke volume and cardiac output while raising left-sided filling pressures.

variables.name: APL
variables.label: Anaphylaxis
variables.description: Severe systemic allergic reaction causing massive vasodilation and reduced peripheral resistance.

variables.name: ANES
variables.label: Insufficient anesthesia / analgesia
variables.description: Inadequate anaesthetic depth or analgesia; triggers sympathetic activation and elevated catecholamine release.

variables.name: PMB
variables.label: Pulmonary embolus
variables.description: Obstruction of pulmonary vasculature by thrombus; raises pulmonary artery pressure and creates ventilation-perfusion mismatch.

variables.name: INT
variables.label: Intubation status
variables.description: Position of the endotracheal tube; ESOPHAGEAL means the tube is misplaced in the oesophagus; ONESIDED means right or left mainstem bronchus intubation.

variables.name: KINK
variables.label: Kinked breathing tube
variables.description: Obstruction of the endotracheal or breathing tube by kinking; reduces or eliminates ventilation delivery.

variables.name: DISC
variables.label: Circuit disconnection
variables.description: Separation of the breathing circuit from the patient or ventilator; results in zero ventilation delivery.

variables.name: LVV
variables.label: Left ventricular end-diastolic volume
variables.description: Volume of blood in the left ventricle at end of diastole; the primary preload determinant of stroke volume.

variables.name: STKV
variables.label: Stroke volume
variables.description: Blood volume ejected per heartbeat; determined by preload (LVV), contractility (LVF), and afterload (TPR).

variables.name: CCHL
variables.label: Catecholamine level
variables.description: Circulating catecholamines (adrenaline/noradrenaline); elevated by insufficient anaesthesia and low cardiac output states; drives heart rate and vascular tone.

variables.name: ERLO
variables.label: Error / low output flag
variables.description: Monitoring alarm flag triggered by a low cardiac output or low-output error condition.

variables.name: HR
variables.label: Heart rate
variables.description: Intrinsic heart rate state driven by catecholamine level and autonomic tone; one multiplicative factor in cardiac output.

variables.name: ERCA
variables.label: Electrocautery in use
variables.description: Use of electrosurgical cautery; introduces electrical artefact that can corrupt EKG-based heart rate readings.

variables.name: SHNT
variables.label: Intrapulmonary shunt
variables.description: Fraction of cardiac output bypassing ventilated alveoli; elevated shunt causes hypoxaemia refractory to supplemental oxygen.

variables.name: PVS
variables.label: Pulmonary venous oxygen saturation
variables.description: Oxygen saturation of blood returning from the lungs to the left heart; determined by alveolar ventilation and shunt.

variables.name: ACO2
variables.label: Arterial CO2
variables.description: Arterial partial pressure of CO2; determined by alveolar ventilation and metabolic CO2 production.

variables.name: VALV
variables.label: Alveolar ventilation
variables.description: Gas exchange occurring at the alveolar level; determined by lung ventilation minus anatomical dead space.

variables.name: VLNG
variables.label: Lung ventilation
variables.description: Total ventilation reaching the lungs; reduced by intubation misplacement, kinking, or disconnection.

variables.name: VTUB
variables.label: Tube ventilation
variables.description: Ventilation passing through the endotracheal tube; affected by tube position, kinking, and circuit integrity.

variables.name: VMCH
variables.label: Ventilator machine output
variables.description: Volume output delivered by the mechanical ventilator; determined by the set minute volume target.
